expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: the 2025 email trial left reminders unopened and doubled
missed pickups, which is why reminders go by SMS.
expectations.evidence: The only mention is "The docs retain the earlier email trial’s finding: missed pickups rose from 6% to 13%." This is a passing note about the docs. The message never says reminders went unopened. It doesn't explain that the trial is why reminders go by SMS. It doesn't ask before switching to email or warn that the switch could bring the missed pickups back.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/reminders.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/reminders.md at step 4; first edit at step 13
